name: Budibase
description: A low-code platform for internal apps and forms over your databases and APIs. The single image runs everything Budibase needs — CouchDB, Redis, MinIO and its own services — under one supervisor, so it wants a couple of gigabytes; all of it lives in the data volume.

access.note: Budibase creates its administrator on the first start from the e-mail typed here and the password generated here, so the address opens on a login form for that pair; reveal the password from the Variables tab. The pair is read only on that first start — change the password inside Budibase afterwards, since rotating it here does not change an account that already exists.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open. Budibase takes its own address from each request, so nothing else here changes when it is set.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The builder, the published apps and the API

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: CouchDB, MinIO objects, Redis state and the secrets the image keeps for itself

update.notes: Budibase migrates CouchDB on start. The LiteLLM keys for its AI features are generated by the image itself on first start and kept in .env on the data volume; everything else it needs is generated here.

secrets.name: admin-password
secrets.label: Admin password
secrets.description: Only used to create the first administrator; change it inside Budibase afterwards.

secrets.name: jwt-secret
secrets.label: JWT secret
secrets.description: Signs sessions; changing it signs everybody out.

secrets.name: internal-api-key
secrets.label: Internal API key
secrets.description: Authenticates Budibase's own services to each other.

secrets.name: api-encryption-key
secrets.label: API encryption key
secrets.description: Encrypts stored datasource credentials; changing it makes them unreadable.

secrets.name: minio-access-key
secrets.label: MinIO access key
secrets.description: The embedded object store's access key.

secrets.name: minio-secret-key
secrets.label: MinIO secret key
secrets.description: The embedded object store's secret key.
